messages:
Vikram: Deploy to prod-nyc completed at 14:15 PT. Image: ghcr.io/redwood/inference:release-2024.11.22-8. Leaving post-deploy watches for 30m. @Sre-oncall @eng-releases can you run smoke checks? Rolling policy is 50% canary -> stable.

Deploy-bot: Deployment succeeded: rollout 12/12 pods on service inference-prod. Trigger: ci/main#876. Link: <https://ci.redwood.dev/build/876|build/876> :rocket:

Maria: Quick dashboards check — tail latency looks normal, p50 ~ 18ms, p95 ~ 120ms. No error spikes in traces. :white_check_mark:

Liam: Hitting /healthcheck, all 200s from my side. Command I used: `curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" https://prod.inference.redwood.com/health` -> 200

Jen: Running an embeddings smoke (sample batch). Results look good. Saw a low-frequency "warning: KV cache refill" in logs. Quick grep I ran: ```kubectl logs -l app=inference -n prod | tail -n 50 | grep KV```

Tara: Metrics glance: token cost per request stable, replicas CPU ~63% avg across pool, no OOMs. :thumbsup:

Sre-oncall: Watching error budget dashboard. Rolling error rate 0.08% over last 10m (< alert threshold). If it hits >=0.5% I'll escalate. Confirming rollback tag is prepared.

Vikram: Rollback tag created: release/2024-11-22-rollback-8. Rollback command if needed: ```kubectl set image deploy/inference inference=ghcr.io/redwood/inference:release-2024.11.22-7 -n prod```

Maria: Noticed config drift on node gpu-07 (driver mismatch). Restarting pod on that node to pick new daemonset. Will update.

Deploy-bot: Pod inference-9 restarted on node gpu-07. Event: kubelet eviction -> restart.

Liam: After restart canary pings are still 200. Proposal: keep 30m watch unless we see regressions — ok to extend to 45m on request.

Jen: FYI QA harness flagged one translation test as failed (deterministic diff). Creating INT-3421 to track. Not visible in prod traffic but want product aware. @product

Vikram: Thanks. If nothing critical in the next ~25m I'll close the watch. Please post any quick fixes here. :eyes:

Tara: Minute-zero checklist: verify model quantization artifacts loaded at /models/ggml/*.q4_0 on all pods.

Sre-oncall: Confirmed quant files present on 11/12 pods; pod inference-3 missing q4_0. Maria on it.

Maria: Syncing missing file from s3 to inference-3 now and verifying checksum.

Maria: Done — checksum matches, quant file present on inference-3. Re-running a couple of smoke requests to confirm.

Vikram: Final check: metrics stable, canaries healthy, no rollback. Closing watch at 14:44 PT. Thanks all — great coordination. :tada:
